elements.description: Logical identity-platform service for user and application authentication and token issuance.

elements.name: Directory and administration API
elements.description: Logical directory and Microsoft Graph-facing boundary for users, groups, applications and policies.

elements.name: Cloud Sync provisioning service
elements.description: Orchestrates selected AD object synchronization and commits directory changes.

elements.name: Cloud Sync provisioning agent
elements.description: Customer-managed runtime that queries AD DS through outbound-established communication with the provisioning service.
elements.technology: Microsoft Entra provisioning agent / Windows service

elements.name: Identity protocol endpoints
elements.description: Logical reference: Accepts OIDC authorization and OAuth token requests.

elements.name: Identity authentication
elements.description: Logical reference: Validates configured user or application authentication proof.

elements.name: Access-policy evaluation
elements.description: Logical reference: Applies applicable sign-in and access requirements for this identity and resource.

elements.name: Token issuance
elements.description: Logical reference: Issues signed ID and access tokens with audience-specific claims.

elements.name: Directory administration API
elements.description: Logical reference: Accepts authorized directory reads and changes through public administrative interfaces.

elements.name: Directory authorization
elements.description: Logical reference: Checks caller permissions for the requested directory resource operation.

elements.name: Directory object access
elements.description: Logical reference: Reads and writes identity, group, application and policy records.

elements.name: Provisioning orchestration
elements.description: Logical reference: Schedules scoped synchronization work and tracks incremental progress.

elements.name: Provisioning mapping and processing
elements.description: Logical reference: Processes returned attributes according to configured scopes and mappings.

elements.name: Directory update client
elements.description: Logical reference: Commits processed object changes to the Entra directory.

elements.name: Outbound service channel
elements.description: Logical reference: Receives synchronization requests through the agent-established service connection.

elements.name: AD query connector
elements.description: Logical reference: Queries scoped AD objects and returns requested attributes.

elements.name: Synchronization response
elements.description: Logical reference: Returns directory data and progress information to cloud provisioning.

elements.name: Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services
elements.description: Directory identities, LDAP queries and Kerberos authentication for the enterprise domain.

elements.name: Domain-controller services
elements.description: Logical AD DS runtime; no server instances, sites or replication topology are modeled.

elements.name: AD directory data store
elements.description: Domain-controller-owned directory objects, schema and account records.

elements.name: SYSVOL store
elements.description: Domain-controller-owned policy templates and scripts; no filesystem deployment is specified.

elements.name: LDAP directory interface
elements.description: Logical reference: Accepts directory searches and authenticated binds.

elements.name: Kerberos KDC
elements.description: Logical reference: Validates domain authentication and issues Kerberos tickets.

elements.name: Directory access and authorization
elements.description: Logical reference: Applies directory permissions and resolves requested account attributes.

elements.name: Directory persistence
elements.description: Logical reference: Reads and writes directory objects and account records.

elements.name: Directory replication responsibility
elements.description: Logical reference: Processes directory change records; controller topology is deliberately omitted.

elements.name: Group Policy and SYSVOL access
elements.description: Logical reference: Supplies domain policy metadata and policy-file references.

elements.name: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services
elements.description: Federates AD-backed identities and issues claims to relying parties; separate from directory synchronization.

elements.name: AD FS federation service
elements.description: Authenticates users and issues claims under configured relying-party trust policy.

elements.name: AD FS configuration store
elements.description: Stores trust, claim-rule and federation configuration; WID is the reference store choice.

elements.name: Federation protocol endpoints
elements.description: Logical reference: Accepts relying-party requests and returns browser-mediated federation responses.

elements.name: Authentication adapters
elements.description: Logical reference: Validates user authentication through configured domain mechanisms.

elements.name: Claims engine
elements.description: Logical reference: Transforms incoming claims and directory attributes using configured claim rules.

elements.name: Token issuance
elements.description: Logical reference: Signs and issues claims tokens for the configured relying party.

elements.name: Trust and configuration access
elements.description: Logical reference: Loads relying-party trusts, claims rules and signing configuration.

elements.name: Federation auditing
elements.description: Logical reference: Records authentication, claims issuance outcome and request context.

elements.name: Proposed HSM signing adapter
elements.description: Optional custom Ethereum RPC signing proxy; requires implementation and compatibility testing. Not built into FireFly Signer.
elements.technology: Reference adapter / Ethereum JSON-RPC + Azure REST

elements.name: Transaction preparation
elements.description: Proposed reference: Prepares chain-aware Ethereum signing payloads and Keccak-256 digests; preserves supplied transaction fields.

elements.name: HSM access client
elements.description: Proposed reference: Acquires an Entra application token and requests signing with the selected non-exportable secp256k1 key.

elements.name: Signature conversion and validation
elements.description: Proposed reference: Normalizes low-s, determines recovery parity and verifies the Ethereum sender before transaction encoding.

elements.name: RPC submission
elements.description: Proposed reference: Submits the encoded signed transaction to Besu and returns the transaction hash or RPC error.
